title: Strange New World
setup: Goku, Vegeta, Naruto, and Sasuke have each been pulled from their own worlds and dropped into a vast, unfamiliar landscape. Their powers seem intact, but the sky has unfamiliar stars and none of them knows how they arrived. They have just noticed one another. Let the characters meet naturally, compare what they know, and work together to figure out where they are and how to get home. Stay in character, respond to the previous speakers, and do not decide the mystery too quickly.
